create_towel_task: create a Towel task instance that places a soft-body towel on the tabletop in the Aloha simulation environment
initialize_towel_episode: initialize an episode to randomly place the towel prop on the table using PropPlacer with uniform position and z-axis rotation
get_towel_reward: get the reward for the Towel task which always returns 0.0 as a base task with no intrinsic reward
configure_towel_position: configure the towel uniform position distribution to randomize placement within a 0.2x0.2 meter area on the tabletop
configure_towel_rotation: configure the towel z-axis rotation distribution to randomize orientation within plus or minus 9 degrees around the vertical axis
